source_description: The dataset card states that the original images were obtained from Narutopedia and captioned using a pretrained BLIP image-captioning model.
license_status: No explicit dataset license is declared in the pinned Hugging Face repository metadata.
license_reporting_policy: No license is inferred or assigned when the dataset publisher does not declare one.

limitations.name: machine_generated_caption_noise
limitations.description: Captions were generated with a pretrained BLIP model rather than manually verified, so captions may be generic, incomplete, grammatically imperfect, or visually misaligned.

limitations.name: narrow_domain_sampling_bias
limitations.description: The dataset contains Naruto-related anime imagery and is not representative of a broad natural-image or general text-to-image distribution.

provenance_consideration: The underlying imagery comes from a pre-existing entertainment franchise, while the pinned dataset repository does not declare an explicit license. Downstream-use rights therefore require separate consideration beyond this technical course experiment.
